anna: Pen test report from external assessor uploaded to secure share: s3://redwood-pt/ACME-2025-03-01/report.zip. Quick skim: 2 x P2 (RBAC overly broad, KMS decrypt exposure), several P3s. Need triage owners and a retest window. Who can own the RBAC change + audit export?
kevin: I can own RBAC mapping + PR. Need current role snapshots and timestamped audit logs (CloudTrail/innodb). @jordan can you pull the trails for 2025-02-25..2025-03-03?
jordan: On it, grabbing logs now. ETA ~2h. Will stage a presigned S3 link and post here when ready. :thumbsup:
sasha: For the KMS item — can you confirm whether this is a key policy issue (principal in policy) or an IAM policy granting `kms:Decrypt`? If you have the policy snippet paste it.
anna: Looks like IAM role `service/legacy-ingest` has `kms:Decrypt` on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Attacher left broad `Resource: *` in one inline policy. Retest preferred Tue/Wed next week 09:00-13:00 PST. Need rollback playbook too.
kevin: Proposal: remove `kms:Decrypt` from `service/legacy-ingest` and create a scoped role `service/ingest-shard` with least privilege. Draft CLI change (will add to PR):
```
# remove decrypt from legacy role
rbacctl update-role service/legacy-ingest --revoke kms:Decrypt
# create scoped role
rbacctl create-role service/ingest-shard --allow "kms:Decrypt:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" --note "scoped for shard ingest"
```
jordan: I'll prepare the infra PR and attach the log export. For audit sampling, will capture: CloudTrail (management events), KMS Data events, IAM, STS. Export command I'm using: `./scripts/export-audit --from 2025-02-25 --to 2025-03-03 --services cloudtrail,kms,iam --out s3://redwood-pt/pt-evidence/ACME/`
security-bot: New ticket created: PT-4521 | Severity: P2 | Owner: kevin | Due: 2025-03-10 | Tags: [rbac,kms,evidence]
sasha: For retest access — prefer ephemeral assessor access via SSO + timeboxed role. Avoid giving decrypt rights to a static service principal. We can add an `assessor:decrypt` role with session duration 1 hour.
kevin: Agree. Will add `assessor:allow` to PR with conditional `aws:RequestedRegion` and `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent`. Rollback plan (short):
1) Revert PR -> restore legacy role policy
2) Re-run ingest smoke tests against canary namespace
3) If failure, fail open to read-only ingestion and escalate to oncall
I will document steps in PR template.
anna: Action items summarized: kevin owns RBAC change + rollback docs, jordan owns log export + evidence upload, sasha owns KMS policy change & approver. Retest slot set for Tue 2025-03-11 09:00 PST. @security-bot please add calendar invite to #eng-security.
security-bot: Calendar invite sent to #eng-security and attendees. :calendar:
